a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. Storm odds are high, but grabbing early would leave one of us dead and break our deal. Let's operate together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. If the generator runs this round and next, we hit 8 and take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
